headline: Argentina approves incentives for $50,750 million gas megaproject
summary: Argentina LNG won approval from the evaluation committee of the RIGI large-investment incentive regime. The project is valued at $50.75 billion, according to the input.
why: RIGI is Argentina's incentive regime for large investments, and LNG export projects bring foreign capital and export revenue into the country's energy sector.
original_headline: Argentina aprueba incentivos para megaproyecto gasífero por 50,750 millones de dólares
